about: READ-ONLY: what is consuming this host's disk — df, BOTH docker daemons (system: the CI jobs; rootless: the converge builds), and a fixed list of directories largest-first. No arguments, nothing mutated; sudo -n is tried where root is needed and each line says when it was refused. Added 2026-09-05 after the locomotive refused #204 at 65GB and the bounded reclaim stopped at the floor with nobody able to say what held the rest (David: 'I want to understand what is consuming disk first').
